name: Lynx Global Digital Finance Corporation
summary: CannaOne Technologies Inc., a software development and technology company, develops and markets online e-commerce marketplace solution for the cannabis industry in Canada. It provides BloomKit, a software suite that delivers an online toolkit for various applications for companies in the cannabis sector; and BWell, which uses BloomKit to facilitate the sale of premium CBD products on its online marketplace. The company also operates Primo, a review driven marketplace that show a dispensary directory, brand pages, visual product attributes, and multi-varied cannabis centric reviews. CannaOne Technologies Inc. was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
